title: Oozy Golden French Apple Tarte Tatin
description: A rich and decadent French dessert featuring caramelized apples and a crispy pastry crust, perfect for a special treat. This ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly recipe uses peanut oil for a unique flavor and wood-fired baking for a crispy crust.

ingredients.name: apples
ingredients.notes: Granny Smith or other tart variety

instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
Peel and halve the apples, then toss with sugar and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine flour and salt, then add cold butter and use a pastry blender to work it into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add water to the bowl, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together in a ball.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and roll it out to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Brush the dough with peanut oil, then arrange the apple halves in a circular pattern, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the pastry up over the apples, pressing gently to seal.
Brush the pastry with egg wash, then bake the tarte tatin in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the apples are caramelized.
Remove the tarte tatin from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the tarte tatin warm, topped with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream if desired.
